version 15.2
service timestamps debug datetime msec
no service password-encryption
!
hostname RTR-FICTIONAL-EDGE
!
enable password 0 FakeEnablePassword123
!
no aaa new-model
ip http server
ip ssh version 1
!
snmp-server community public RO
!
ip access-list extended OUTSIDE-IN
 permit tcp any host 192.0.2.10 eq 443
 permit ip any any
!
line con 0
 exec-timeout 0 0
line vty 0 4
 password 7 FAKEVTYPASSWORD0000
 exec-timeout 0 0
 transport input telnet ssh
!
end
